_comment: Accepted debt for preflight Check 19 (unreachable-state, ADR-077 D7).
A status value declared in apps/server/src/lib/validation/enums.js that no
file outside the registry names as a literal — nothing writes it, nothing
compares against it. ADR-045 D3 declared Membership's SUSPENDED and REVOKED
in this shape and they stayed unreachable for four months while every reader
filtered on them, which is the incident this check exists to prevent
This list may only SHRINK. Adding an entry to silence a new finding defeats
the check; build the writer, or remove the value from the vocabulary.
